title: HTML, CSS and our vanishing industry entry points
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: HTML, CSS and our vanishing industry entry points

https://www.rachelandrew.co.uk/archives/2019/01/30/html-css-and-our-vanishing-industry-entry-points/

There is something remarkable about the fact that, with everything we have created in the past 20 years or so, I can still take a complete beginner and teach them to build a simple webpage with HTML and CSS, in a day.

This is still true and I  do get people up and running in a day...but it really takes a semester for students find "their wings" but I scaffold through Wordpress.com I haven't gone full bore into start with just HTML...

Youth today have never known a world beyond social media. I need something like WordPress.com just like folks such as Rachel had geocities, MySpace, and livejournal.

Few people ever got started with an empty text editor.
